conversation.message: What exactly is baseload power?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Baseload power refers to the minimum amount of electric power needed to be supplied to the electrical grid at any given time. It's the constant, steady demand that the grid must always meet.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: So it's like the essential, always-on power supply?
